semantics: Presence means at least the configured patch fraction; adjacency requires both presence thresholds and configured shared boundary. Natural language does not numerically restate thresholds. Paraphrases share exactly one intent condition.

families.arable-pasture: Singles for arable land and pasture, their conjunction and their adjacency share one direct family.
